title: Strobogrammatic Number II
statement: Given an array of integers, find the maximum product of a contiguous subarray within the array. A subarray is a contiguous subset of the array. The product of a subarray is the product of all the elements in the subarray. If the array is empty, return 0. Note that the product can be negative, so we need to consider the case where the maximum product is achieved by including negative numbers.
